metaDescription: Order custom 1000 mAh lanyards badges with built-in power banks. Perfect for trade shows and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Choosing lanyards with a 1000 mAh power bank means your attendees can recharge their devices on the go without carrying extra cables. These lanyards combine a professional look with practical utility, making them ideal for conferences, trade shows, and corporate events. The built-in battery offers enough capacity for a partial phone charge, ensuring your branded lanyards are both memorable and useful. Options like the Rainbow Lanyard or 3/4" Woven Lanyard can be customized with your logo and the power bank feature.
